about: Tags FRUS Explorer adds to the Office of the Historian's taxonomy. TaxonomyGenerator reads this file after the Office's own and adds each tag whose slug the Office's source does not give; a slug the source gives is left as the source gives it. Each tag says why it is here. See TaxonomyOverlay.swift and Planning/Generators-Runbook.md.

tags.reason: Four volumes' TEI carry the tag (frus1952-54v01p2, frus1958-60v03mSupp, frus1977-80v28, frus1981-88v41), and the Office's taxonomy file holds it only inside a comment, as "LGBTQ+ Rights" under Human Rights, so the bundled taxonomy had no name for it. Added as "LGBTQ Rights" under Topics on the owner's word of 2026-10-15 (decision 39 of the 2026-10-14 plan of record, #1622).
